verdict.rationale: Ardent is a Postgres branching tool. An in-product AI assistant that surfaces insights or suggestions is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) can work against Ardent branches. That is a user-side or adjacent workflow, not Ardent itself generating AI insights from your data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
